keys.desc: Year. The primary partition column across the mirror — filter on it in every query against a large table.
Occupation code (CBO 2002). Joins RAIS, CAGED and the CNES professional tables.
Brazilian postal code. The directory maps every CEP to id_municipio, so it is a usable bridge when a source has an address but no municipality code.
ICD-10 category (3 characters) of the main diagnosis.
CNAE 1.0 activity code — the pre-2007 vintage, still used by older RAIS files.
CNAE 2.0 economic-activity subclass, 7 digits. Joins RAIS, CAGED and the CNPJ base to the activity description.
14-digit company tax ID (8 base + 4 branch + 2 check digits). br_me_cnpj.estabelecimentos is the reference: every active and extinct establishment in Brazil.
First 8 digits of the CNPJ — the company, without the branch. One row per company in br_me_cnpj.empresas.
SIAFI municipality code (4 digits), used by the CGU social-benefit extracts (Garantia-Safra, Pé-de-Meia, Seguro Defeso).
11-digit individual tax ID.

A single column holding either a CPF or a CNPJ, used by three scraped enforcement datasets (PGFN debt, BCB penalties, TCU disqualifications). Tell them apart by digit count after stripping punctuation: 11 = CPF, 14 = CNPJ.
Full date. Event-level microdata tables use it instead of ano/mes.
Date of birth. The usual disambiguator when a masked CPF is not unique.
Full state name, in the two datasets that spell it out.
Student ID inside a survey wave.
CNO — construction-works registry ID, links br_rf_cno tables to each other.
Contract ID. Joins contract items, amendments (termo_aditivo) and apostilamentos.
Higher-education course code.
Câmara dos Deputados member ID. Joins the member to expenses, votes, committees and parliamentary fronts.
IBGE district code (municipality subdivision). Vintage-specific: 1991, 2000 and 2010 meshes are separate directory tables.
Budget commitment (empenho) ID — the link between a tender and money actually committed.
Primary-care team code (CNES equipe).
INEP school code (8 digits). Joins the school census, IDEB, SAEB, the socioeconomic indicator and the school geolocation.
CNES health-establishment code (7 digits). The spine of the SUS datasets: it joins CNES's own 18 tables and reaches SIH/SIA production.
Higher-education institution code.
ENEM registration ID. Joins the microdata to the year's socioeconomic questionnaire.
Tender ID. Joins the tender to its items, participants, empenhos and contracts.
IBGE mesoregion code.
IBGE microregion code.

7-digit IBGE municipality code, stored as VARCHAR (zero-padding matters — 1100015, never 1100015.0). This is the join key to reach for; every other municipality column below exists to be converted into it.
IBGE municipality code without the check digit (6 digits). Used by DATASUS systems (CNES, SINAN, SIH) and by the older health aggregates.
Banco Central municipality code. Present only in the directory — it is there so BCB extracts (ESTBAN, SICOR) that carry it can be brought back to IBGE codes.
Receita Federal municipality code (4 digits). This is the **only** municipality column in br_me_cnpj.estabelecimentos — geolocating any company in the CNPJ base goes through it.
TSE (Electoral Court) municipality code — a short sequential number, unique only inside a UF. Every electoral table keys on it.
Legal-nature code (whether an entity is a municipality, a foundation, an LTDA…). Essential to tell public bodies from private companies in the CNPJ base.
Mercosur product code (8 digits). The join key for foreign-trade data.
Government organ code. In the CGU procurement datasets it pairs with id_orgao_superior; in br_camara_dados_abertos it identifies committees.
Country code. br_bd_diretorios_mundo.pais carries every common encoding (M49, FAO, GAUL, ISO2/ISO3, COI, FIFA) — use it to reconcile international datasets.
IBGE macro-region code (1 = Norte … 5 = Centro-Oeste).
IBGE immediate region (the 2017 replacement for microregions).
IBGE intermediate region (replaces mesoregions).
Metropolitan region code.
SUS health region — the administrative unit health policy is planned on.
15-digit IBGE census tract code — the finest geography in the mirror. Its first 7 digits are the id_municipio.
Harmonized System heading (4 digits) — the aggregation level above NCM.
IBGE subdistrict code, one level below the district.
Class ID in the school census.
2-digit IBGE state code (35 = São Paulo). The first two digits of every id_municipio.
Budget management unit (UG) code — the level actual spending is attributed to.
Month (1–12). Always use together with ano; a few tables carry mes alone and are ambiguous without it.
Municipality *name* (not a code), under the shortest possible name. Six datasets use it, and each one stores a different shape — slug, upper case, or name + UF in parentheses.
Municipality name as text. A fallback key — use it only when no code is available, and always normalize both sides.
Administrative process number. Free-form text across sources — normalize digits before joining.
Semester (1–2).
ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. The join key for the world_* datasets.
Party abbreviation. The join between electoral results, party affiliation and Câmara voting records.
Two-letter state abbreviation (SP, RJ). The most widely shared column in the mirror and the safest geographic join.
Quarter (1–4). PNAD Contínua and quarterly economic series.
sigla_uf under a shorter name — what the independently-scraped sources call it, spelled uf or UF depending on the source. Usually the same two-letter code, so it joins sigla_uf directly.
Year, English-named — the world_* and us_* datasets use this instead of ano.
